title: God’s Hope of Innocence
verse: The man and his wife were both naked, but they were not ashamed.
observation: In the beginning, God’s plan for His people was to live in innocence. We were not supposed to have to be concerned with sin, shame, or anything that would bring guilt upon our lives. It was sin that caused us to think negatively about ourselves and others. When we receive salvation, we begin the journey back to the state of innocence God intended for us.
application: Is there a place in your life where you think of yourself only in terms of shame? Where do you need God to bring freedom?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for healing us from the inside out.
